venue.name: [Prva Gimnazija Zagreb](https://www.prva.hr/)
venue.details: Competition will be held in the main hall. / Natjecanje će biti održano u glavnoj prostoriji škole.

items.information:
(HR)

Zagreb Cube Day 2019 je dvanaesto natjecanje po redu koje se održava u Hrvatskoj od 2011. godine. Bilo tko može sudjelovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i
starost, no svatko mora biti upoznat s WCA Pravilnikom.

Natjecanje je pod organizacijom Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Kotizacija pokriva trošak organizacije i najma prostora. Mogući višak kotizacije ide u svrhu razvitka Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska.

--------------

(EN)

Zagreb Cube Day 2019 is the 12th speedcubing competition being held in Croatia since 2011. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations.

This competition is being organized by the Speedcubing Association Croatia. Registration fee covers the cost of the organization and venue rental. Any extra money goes directly to support Speedcubing Association Croatia.

items.information:
**Participants have to bring their own cube for the event.**
On-the-spot (OTS) registration will be also be available as per the times mentioned in the [Schedule Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RaipurSummerCubeopen2019#10277-schedule) for 2x2, 3x3, 3x3 One-Handed and Pyraminx. The fees structure is variable as per information given in the [Registration and Payments Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RaipurSummerCubeopen2019#10275-registrations-payments). 

Please note once you register in WCA site for the Raipur Summer Cube Open 2019, your name will be in waiting list and once your payment is done then your name will appear in competitors list within 1-2 days.
All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except New comers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to Judge (or) Scramble for the entire event, all this will be decided by the organising team and will be informed 2 days before the event, we will make sure that your volunteering will not affect your main events and participation.

***Quick Info links:***
[**Event Schedule**](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RaipurSummerCubeopen2019#competition-schedule)
**[Payment Details](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RaipurSummerCubeopen2019#10275-registrations-payments)**
